final: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM budget GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM cat), joined AS (SELECT c.ratio, c.cnt, o.avg_cnt FROM cat c JOIN overall o ON o.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE c.cnt > o.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_diff FROM joined
